content:
Great concept and very suitable for a clash. Here are my suggestions:
** STATEMENT **
- Please change all instances of [[S]] to [[s]] as that is how the stub-generator generates the variable in the IDE.
- Please remove the extra newline \n in the statement between { ↔ } and "All other characters remain unchanged.

** INPUT **
- Please change all instances of [[S]] to [[s]] just like the statement.

Output is good as is.

** CONSTANTS **
- Please change all instances of [[S]] to [[s]] just like the statement.
- Please change the upper boundary of your constant to a lower value that matches your test cases. Currently, your longest string is 19 characters. My recommendation is to make the longest string 30 characters.

** TEST CASES **
If @5DN1L decides to review as well, he or she may have additional suggestions. But these are mine:
- Currently, none of your visible test cases uses the braces {}. I would add a new case with the braces in the that string.
Sample (you can use a different one): {}qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm{}
My sample also covers the 30 character boundary suggestion, so if you are looking for some ideas, I would use the sample. And for the corresponding validator, you can just delete like 2 characters from the sample and output its corresponding solution.

** STUB GENERATOR **
- Please get rid of read N:int in the stub-generator as it doesn't correspond to the input section and isn't needed to solve this clash.

Thank you!
